title: Leg Day
author: Yasmin C.
desc: A strength-focused lower-body session that builds the glutes, hamstrings, and quads with heavy compound lifts. It starts with barbell box squats and Romanian deadlifts to build strength, adds volume with the leg press and dumbbell Bulgarian split squats, then targets the glutes directly with barbell hip thrusts. A leg curl finishes off the hamstrings. The workout is well suited to anyone who wants stronger, more sculpted legs and glutes from one dedicated day.
